verdict.reasoning: Rendered PDF page 261 (printed 239), 13.5.1: the Term/Subclause table prints three aligned rows: 77-level-entry / 13.11, 77-level data description entry; constant-entry / 13.9, Constant entry; record-description-entry / 13.10, Record description entry. A tool that parses the term table loses the record-description-entry -> 13.10 mapping, which is why this counts as a real structural defect and not normative wording.
